title: A close after the kit's shutdown was cut itself, as a process's end cuts every task, fails with shutdown_cancelled
notes: Python: tests/test_framework.py::TestOneShutdown::test_a_close_after_its_shutdown_was_cut_says_so; roomkit-rs: crates/roomkit/tests/close/shutdown.rs::a_close_after_its_shutdown_was_cut_says_so. The channel's close holds the shutdown at a gate no step opens until the step cuts it. The later caller was cancelled by nobody: it is told the shutdown did not finish, not handed a cancellation of its own.
